adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الغُيُوبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of what You know, and I seek refuge in You from the worst of what You know, and I seek Your forgiveness for all that You know. You know, and we do not know; and You are the All-Knower of the Unseen.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma inni asʾalukal min khayri mā taʿlamu, wa aʿūdhubika min sharri mā taʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka min kulli mā taʿlamu, innaka taʿlamu walā naʿlamu wa anta ʿallāmul ghuyūb.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِي هَذَا وَإِحْدَاقِ الفِتَنِ، وَتَطَاوُلِ أَهْلِ الجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, spare me from [the evils of] this time in which I live; from being encompassed by troubles and trials; and from insolent people's overbearingness against me and persecution of me.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhummarr ḥamnī min zamānī hādhā, wa iḥdāqil fitani wa taṭāwuli ahlil jurʾati ʿalayya wastiḍʿāfihim iyyāy.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ، وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي أَجَلِي مُعَافَى.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, place me in an impregnable refuge of Your giving, and in an inviolable sanctuary from all Your creation, until death's arrival finds me in a state of wellbeing.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma jʿalnī minka fī ʿiyādhin manīʿin, wa ḥirzin ḥaṣīnin, min jamīʿi khalqika ḥatta tuballighanī ajāli muʿāffa.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَنْبَغِي الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَجِبُ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي نُورُهُ مِنْ نُورِ الأَنْوَارِ، وَأَشْرَقَ بِشُعَاعِ سِرِّهِ الأَسْرَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have exalted him, and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have not exalted him. Exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as it is fitting for him to be exalted, and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as he must be exalted, and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as You have ordered us to exalt him; and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad whose light is from the Light of Lights, and whose inner radiance caused all mysteries to shine.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣalla ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tanbaghīṣ ṣalatu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tajibuṣ ṣalātu ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā amarta an yuṣalla ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhi nūruhu min nūril anwāri wa ashraqa bi shuʿāʿi sirrihil asrār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الأَبْرَارِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad and all the People of his righteous House.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ahli baytihil abrāri ajmaʿīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَخَاتِمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ، وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and his Family – the Sea of Your Lights, the Mine of Your Mysteries, the Tongue of Your Proof, the Pearl of Your Kingdom, the Imam of Your Presence, the Seal of Your Prophets – with an exaltation that endures as long as You endure and remains as long as You remain; an exaltation that pleases You and pleases him, and by which You are pleased with us, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi baḥri anwārika, wa maʿdini asrārika, wa lisāni ḥujjatika, wa ʿarūsi mamlakatika, wa imāmi ḥaḍratika, wa khātimi anbiyāʾika, ṣalātan tadūmu bidawāmika, wa tabqa bibaqāʾika, ṣalātan turḍīka wa turḍīhi, wa tarḍa bihā ʿanna yā arḥamar raḥimīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الحِلِّ وَالحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ المَشْعَرِ الحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ البَيْتِ الحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَالمَقَامِ، أَبْلِغْ لِسَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَّا السَّلَامَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of the Ḥill and the Ḥarām, Lord of the Sacred Precinct, Lord of the Sacred House, Lord of the Corner and the Station, convey to our Master and Patron Muḥammad greetings of peace from us.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbal ḥilli wal ḥarām, wa rabbal mashʿaril ḥarām, wa rabbal baytil ḥarām, wa rabbar rukni wal maqām, abligh lisayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin minnās salām.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad, the Master of the first and the last.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin sayyidil awwalīna wal ākhirīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad at every time and moment.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin fī kulli waqtin wa ḥīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad in the Supreme Assembly until the Day of Judgement.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin fīl malaʾil aʿlā ilā yawmiddīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَرِثَ الأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الوَارِثِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad until You inherit the Earth and all that are upon it; 'and You are the Best of Inheritors'.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ḥattā tarithal arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa anta khayrul wārithīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the Family of our Master Muḥammad, as You exalted our Master Abraham. You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious. And bless our Master Muḥammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the Family of our Master Muḥammad, as You blessed our Master Abraham. You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadinin nabiyyil ummiyyi wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdun majīd, wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadinin nabiyyil ummiyyi kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَجَرَى بِهِ قَلَمُكَ، وَسَبَقَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، إِلَى أَبَدِ الأَبَدِ، أَبَدًا، لَا نِهَايَةَ لِأَبَدِيَّتِهِ، وَلَا فَنَاءَ لِدَيْمُومِيَّتِهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Knowledge encompasses and Your Book enumerates, and [as many times] as Your angels have exalted him; with perpetual exaltation enduring as long as You endure; remaining, by Your grace and generosity, to the end of eternity; ceaselessly, with no beginning to it and no end to its perpetuity, for ever and ever.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ma aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka, wa jarā bihi qalamuka, wa sabaqat bihi mashīʾatuka, wa ṣallat ʿalayhi malāʾikatuka, ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi dawāmika, bāqiyyatan bifaḍlika wa iḥsānika, ilā abadil abadi, abadan lā nihāyata liʾabadiyyatihi, wa lā fanāʾa lidaymūmiyyatihi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَارْحَمْ أُمَّتَهُ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Knowledge encompasses and Your Book enumerates, and all that Your angels have witnessed; and be well-pleased with his Companions, and have mercy upon his Nation. You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka, wa aḥṣāhu kitābuka wa shahidat bihi malāʾikatuka, warḍa an aṣḥābihi, warḥam ummatahu innaka ḥamīdun majīd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَصْحَابِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad and all the Companions of our Master Muḥammad.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā jamīʿi aṣ-ḥābi sayyidinā Muḥammad.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as You exalted our Master Abraham; and bless our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as You blessed our Master Abraham and the Family of our Master Abraham in [all] the realms of Being. You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrāhīma fīl ʿālamina innaka ḥamīdun majīd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِخُشُوعِ القَلْبِ عِنْدَ السُّجُودِ، لَكَ يَا سَيِّدِي بِغَيْرِ جُحُودٍ، وَبِكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا جَلِيلُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يُدَانِيكَ فِي غَلِيظِ العُهُودِ، وَبِكُرْسِيِّكَ المُكَلَّلِ بِالنُّورِ إِلَى عَرْشِكَ العَظِيمِ المَجِيدِ، وَبِمَا كَانَ تَحْتَ عَرْشِكَ حَقًّا، قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَصَوْتَ الرُّعُودِ، ذَاكَ إِذْ كُنْتَ مِثْلَ مَا لَمْ تَزَلْ قَطُّ إِلٰهًا عُرِفْتَ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ، فَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ المُحِبِّينَ المَحْبُوبِينَ المُقَرَّبِينَ العَاشِقِينَ لَكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا وَدُودُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, with hearts in reverent prostration to You, o my Master, without evasion or denial, [doing so] by You, o All-Glorious One -- for nothing approaches You in the solemnity of the pledges You exact; by Your Footstool that is crowned with light extending to Your Immense and August Throne; by what in truth was beneath Your Throne before You created the heavens and the sound of thunder. You being as You are, a Deity absolutely Everlasting and recognised as the One and Only, make us to be among Your beloved lovers who are brought close to You, ardent lovers of Yours. O Allah (x 9). O Most Loving One.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma bikhushūʿil qalbi ʿindas sujūd, laka yā sayyidī bighayri juḥūd, wa bika yā Allāhu yā jalīlu falā shayʾa yudānika fī ghalīẓil ʿuhūd, wa bikursiyyikal mukallali binnūri ilā ʿarshikal ʿaẓīmil majīd, wa bimā kāna taḥta ʿarshika ḥaqqan qabla an takhluqas samāwāti wasawtar ruʿūdi, dhāka idh kunta mithla mā lam tazal qaṭṭu ilāhan ʿurifta bittawḥīd, fajʿalnā minal muḥibbīnal maḥbūbīnal muqarrabīnal ʿāshiqīna laka yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā Allāhu yā wadūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Knowledge encompasses.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi ʿilmuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Book enumerates.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥṣāhu kitābuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Omnipotent Power has executed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā nafadhat bihi qudratuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَصَّصَتْهُ إِرَادَتُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Will has specified.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā saiyyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khaṣṣaṣat-hu irādatuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَوَجَّهَ إِلَيْهِ أَمْرُكَ وَنَهْيُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all to which Your commands and prohibitions have been directed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā tawajjaha ilayhi amruka wa nahyuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَسِعَهُ سَمْعُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Hearing has encompassed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā wasiʿahu samʿuka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ بَصَرُكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that Your Sight has encompassed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aḥāṭa bihi baṣaruka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that those who remember have remembered.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā dhakarahudh dhākirūn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الغَافِلُونَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that those who are heedless have been heedless of.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā ghafala ʿan dhikrihil ghāfilūn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الأَمْطَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the drops of rainfall.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada qaṭril ʾamṭār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الأَشْجَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the leaves of the trees.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada awrāqil ʾashjār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ القِفَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the beasts of the wastelands.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muhammmadin ʿadada dawābbil qifār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ البِحَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the creatures of the seas.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada dawābbil biḥār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِيَاهِ البِحَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the waters of the seas.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada miyāhil biḥār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of all that the night has shrouded in darkness and the day has illuminated.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā aẓlama ʿalayhil laylu wa aḍāʾa ʿalayhin nahār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad in the morning and in the evening.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin bil ghuduwwi wal ʾāṣāl.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّمَالِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of the grains of sand.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadadar rimāl.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النِّسَاءِ وَالرِّجَالِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of women and men.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadadan nisāʾi warrijāl.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ رِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad as much as will content You.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin riḍāʾa nafsika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the ink of Your Words.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin midāda kalimātika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Heavens and Your Earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin milʾa samāwātika wa arḍika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the weight of Your Throne.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin zinata ʿarshika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad by the sum of Your creation.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿadada makhlūqātika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad with the finest of Your exaltations.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin afḍala ṣālawātika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Prophet of Mercy.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā nabiyyir raḥmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى شَفِيعِ الأُمَّةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Intercessor for the [Muslim] Nation.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā shafīʿil ummah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى كَاشِفِ الغُمَّةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Reliever from Sorrow.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā kāshifil ghummah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُجْلِي الظُّلْمَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Dispeller of Darkness.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā mujlīẓ ẓulmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُولِي النِّعْمَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Dispenser of Bounty.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā mūlīn niʿmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُؤْتِي الرَّحْمَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Granter of Mercy.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muʾtīr raḥmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الحَوْضِ المَوْرُودِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Sacred Pool Accessed [by believers].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil hawḍil mawrūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المَقَامِ المَحْمُودِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Most Praised Station.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil maqāmil maḥmūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ اللِّوَاءِ المَعْقُودِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Covenanted Banner.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil liwāʾil maʿqūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المَكَانِ المَشْهُودِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Witnessed Location.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil makānil mash-hūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَوْصُوفِ بِالْكَرَمِ وَالجُودِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the one characterised by liberality and generosity.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl mawṣūfi bil karami wal jūd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ هُوَ فِي السَّمَاءِ سَيِّدُنَا مَحْمُودٌ، وَفِي الأَرْضِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who is our Master Maḥmūd in Heaven and our Master Muḥammad on Earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man huwa fissamāʾi maḥmūdun wa fīl arḍi Muḥammadun.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of the Shāmma [the Seal of Prophethood on his back].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibish shāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ العَلَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of the Hallmark.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil ʿalāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَوْصُوفِ بِالكَرَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the one characterised by miraculous feats (karāma).
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl mawṣūfi bil karāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَخْصُوصِ بِالزَّعَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the one singled out for leadership.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl makhṣūṣi bizzaʿāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ تُظِلُّهُ الغَمَامَةُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who was shaded by clouds.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna tuẓilluhul ghamāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ كَمَا يَرَى مَنْ أَمَامَهُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who could see equally well behind as in front of him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna yarā man khalfahu kamā yarā man amāmahu.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ المُشَفَّعِ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Intercessor whose intercession will be accepted on the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalash shafīʿil mushaffaʿī yawmal qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الضَّرَاعَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Humble Entreaty [of Allah].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibiḍ ḍarāʿah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّفَاعَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Intercession.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibi shafāʿah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الوَسِيلَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Wasīla.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil wasīlah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الفَضِيلَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Pre-Eminence.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil faḍīlah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Lofty Rank.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibid darajatir rafīʿah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الهِرَاوَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Cane.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil hirāwah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ النَّعْلَيْنِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Sandals.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibin naʿlayn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الحُجَّةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of the [Sound] Argument.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil ḥujjah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ البُرْهَانِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of the Proof.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil burhān.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ السُّلْطَانِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Authority.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibis sulṭān.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Turban (tāj).
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣaḥibit tāj.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المِعْرَاجِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Maker of the Night Journey.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil miʿrāj.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ القَضِيبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Owner of the Staff.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil qaḍīb.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ النَّجِيبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Rider of Thoroughbred Camels.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rākibin najīb.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ البُرَاقِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Rider of Burāq.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rākibil burāq.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُخْتَرِقِ السَّبْعِ الطِّبَاقِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Traverser of the Seven Heavens.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā mukhtariqis sabʿiṭ ṭibāq.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ فِي جَمِيعِ الأَنَامِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Intercessor for All Creatures.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalash shafīʿi fī jamīʿil anām.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَ فِي كَفِّهِ الطَّعَامُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him in whose hand food glorified [Allah].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sabbaḥa fī kafhiṭ ṭaʿām.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بَكَى إِلَيْهِ الجِذْعُ وَحَنَّ لِفِرَاقِهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him for whom a [palm] trunk wept and moaned at being parted from him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man bakā ilayhil jidhʿu wa ḥanna lifirāqih.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَوَسَّلَ بِهِ طَيْرُ الفَلَاةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him whose mediation was sought by a bird of the countryside.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tawassala bihi ṭayrul falāh.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَتْ فِي كَفِّهِ الحَصَاةُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him in whose hand pebbles glorified [Allah].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sabbaḥat fī kafihil ḥaṣāh.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَشَفَّعَ إِلَيْهِ الظَّبْيُ بِأَفْصَحِ كَلَامٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him whose intercession was sought by a gazelle in the most eloquent speech.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tashaffaʿa ilayhiẓ ẓabyu bi afṣaḥi kalām.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَلَّمَهُ الضَّبُّ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ الأَعْلَامِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him to whom a lizard spoke [and testified] in a gathering of his most exalted Companions.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kallamahuḍ ḍabbu fī majlisihi maʿa aṣ-ḥābihil aʿlām.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى البَشِيرِ النَّذِيرِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Bringer of Good News and Warner.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl bashīrin nadhīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السِّرَاجِ المُنِيرِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Light-Giving Lamp.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalas sirājil munīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْهِ البَعِيرُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him to whom a camel complained [of its ill-treatment].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man shakā ilayhil baʿīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَفَجَّرَ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ المَاءُ النَّمِيرُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him from between whose fingers pure water welled out.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tafajjara min bayni aṣābiʿihil māʾun namīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّاهِرِ المُطَهَّرِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Pure One, the Purifier.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāṭ ṭāhiril muṭahhar.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نُورِ الأَنْوَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Light of Lights.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā nūril anwār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ انْشَقَّ لَهُ القَمَرُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him for whom the moon was split.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā manin shaqqa lahul qamar.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّيِّبِ المُطَيَّبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Goodly, the Fragrant One.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāṭ ṭayyibil muṭayyab.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ المُقَرَّبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Emissary brought close [to Allah].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalar rasūlil muqarrab.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الفَجْرِ السَّاطِعِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Brilliant Dawn.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl fajris sāṭiʿ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّجْمِ الثَّاقِبِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Piercing Star.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalan najmith thāqib.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى العُرْوَةِ الوُثْقَى.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Most Trusty Handhold.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl ʿurwatil wuthqa.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَذِيرِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Warner of the People of the Earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā nadhīri ahlil arḍ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ يَوْمَ العَرْضِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Intercessor on the Day of Petition.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalash shafīʿi yawmal ʿarḍ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السَّاقِي لِلنَّاسِ مِنَ الحَوْضِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who shall give people to drink from the Sacred Pool.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalas sāqi linnāsi minal ḥawḍ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ لِوَاءِ الحَمْدِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of the Banner of Praise.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi liwāʾil ḥamd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُشَمِّرِ عَنْ سَاعِدِ الجِدِّ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who rolled up the sleeve of the forearm of earnest endeavour.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl mushammiri an sāʿidil jidd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُسْتَعْمِلِ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ غَايَةَ الجُهْدِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who strove his utmost to gain Your good pleasure.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl mustaʿmili marḍātika ghāyatal juhd.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الخَاتِمِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Prophet, the Seal
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalān nabiyyil khātim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ الخَاتِمِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Final Emissary.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalār rasūlil khātim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُصْطَفَى القَائِمِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Chosen One, the Upright One.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl muṣṭafal qāʾim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَسُولِكَ أَبِي القَاسِمِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt Your Emissary, the Father of Qāsim.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā rasūlika abīl qāsim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الآيَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Signs.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil āyāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّلَالَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Indications.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibid dilālāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الإِشَارَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Allusions.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil ishārāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الكَرَامَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Supernatural Feats.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil karāmāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ العَلَامَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Hallmarks.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil ʿalāmāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ البَيِّنَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Explications.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil bayyināt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المُعْجِزَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Miracles.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibil muʿjizāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ خَوَارِقِ العَادَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Possessor of Extraordinary Events.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā ṣāḥibi khawāriqil ʿādāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَلَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِ الأَحْجَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him who was saluted by stones.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sallamat ʿalayhil aḥjār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَجَدَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ الأَشْجَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him before whom trees prostrated.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man sajadat bayna yadayhil ashjār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَفَتَّقَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ الأَزْهَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him in whose Light flowers bloomed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man tafattaqat min nūrihil azhār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ طَابَتْ بِبَرَكَتِهِ الثِّمَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him by whose blessing fruit ripened.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man ṭābat bi barakatihith thimār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ اخْضَرَّتْ مِنْ بَقِيَّةِ وَضُوئِهِ الأَشْجَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him from whose leftover ablution water trees became green.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā manikhḍarrat min baqiyyati waḍūʾihil ashjār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ فَاضَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ جَمِيعُ الأَنْوَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him from whose Light all other lights flowed.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man fāḍat min nūrihi jamīʿul anwār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُحَطُّ الأَوْزَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him through whose exaltation loads are set down.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣṣalāti ʿalayhi tuḥaṭṭul awzār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ مَنَازِلُ الأَبْرَارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him through whose exaltation the stations of the most righteous are attained.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣṣalāti ʿalayhi tunālu manāzilul abrār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ يُرْحَمُ الكِبَارُ وَالصِّغَارُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him through whose exaltation the old and the young receive mercy.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣṣalāti ʿalayhi yurḥamul kibāru waṣṣighār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ نَتَنَعَّمُ فِي هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَفِي تِلْكَ الدَّارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him by whose exaltation this Abode and that Abode are benefited.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣṣalati ʿalayhi natanaʿamu fī hādhihid dāri wa fī tilkad dār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ رَحْمَةُ العَزِيزِ الغَفَّارِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him through whose exaltation mercy is gained from the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man biṣṣalāti ʿalayhi tunālu raḥmatul ʿazīzil ghaffār.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَنْصُورِ المُؤَيَّدِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Victorious One, the [Divinely-]Aided One.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl manṣūril muʾayyad.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُخْتَارِ المُمَجَّدِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt the Elect, the Illustrious.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalāl mukhtāril mumajjad.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master and Patron Muḥammad.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammad.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى فِي البَرِّ الأَقْفَرِ تَعَلَّقَتِ الوُحُوشُ بِأَذْيَالِهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt him to whose robe-hems wild animals clung as he walked in desert lands.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā man kāna idha mashā fīl barril aqfari taʿallaqatil wuḥūshu biʾadhyālihi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt and bestow abundant salutations on him, his Family, and his Companions. And all praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa ṣallim tasliman kathira, walḥamdu liLlāhi rabbil ʿālamīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى حِلْمِهِ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ، وَعَلَى عَفْوِهِ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهِ.
adhkar.translation: All praise be to Allah for His forbearance despite His Knowledge, and His forgivingness despite His Omnipotence.
adhkar.transliteration: AlḥamduliLlahi ʿalā ḥilmihi, baʿda ʿilmihi, wa ʿalā ʿafwihi baʿda qudratihi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا، أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا، أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ، وَعُضَالِ الدَّاءِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from all poverty except in relation to You; and from all humility which is not towards You, and from all fear that is not fear of You. I seek refuge in You from speaking falsehoods, from being deceitful and immoral, and from being deluded about You. And I seek refuge in You from my enemies gloating over me, from chronic illness, from hopes being dashed, from the disappearance of blessings, and from affliction by disaster.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma inni aʿūdhu bika minal faqri illā illayka, wa minadhulli illā laka, wa minal khawfi illā minka, wa aʿūdhu bika an aqūla zūra, aw aghsha fujūra, aw akūna bika maghrūra, wa aʿūdhu bika min shamātatil aʿdāʾi, wa ʿuḍāliddāʾi wa khaybatir rajāʾi, wa zawālin niʿmati, wa fujāʾatin niqmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ حَبِيبُكَ (3)
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt and preserve our Master Muḥammad, and reward him on our behalf as much as he deserves, being Your Beloved. (x 3)
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa sallim ʿalayhi wajzihi ʿannā mā huwa ahluhu ḥabībuka (3).

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ خَلِيلُكَ (3)
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt and preserve our Master Abraham, and reward him on our behalf as much as he deserves, being Your Close Friend. (x 3)
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa ṣallim ʿalayhi wajhzihi ʿanna ma huwa ahluhu khalilūka (3).

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as You exalted, were merciful to, and blessed our Master Abraham and the Family of our Master Abraham in [all] the realms of Being. You are All-Praiseworthy, All-Glorious. [All these exaltations being] as numerous as Your creation and as is pleasing to You, by the weight of Your Throne, and by the ink of Your Words.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta wa raḥimta wa bārakta ʿalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Ibrahima fīl ʿālamīna innaka ḥamīdun majīd,ʿadada khalqika wa riḍāʾa nafsika wa zinata ʿarshika wa midāda kalimātika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have exalted him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣalla ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have not exalted him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as many times as he has been exalted.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā ṣulliya ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَضْعَافَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as many times as he has been exalted, and many times over.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aḍʿāfa mā ṣulliya ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as he deserves.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā huwa ahluhu.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى لَهُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as You like and as You are content with for him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā lahu.
